title: Realm 1: The Royal Data Vault
description: Query database tables, filter rows with WHERE, and sort results.

lessons.title: 1. Inspecting Tables (SELECT *)
lessons.concept:
### What is a Database? 🗄️
Every game, bank, and social network stores its data in tables (like supercharged Excel sheets).

In SQL, **`SELECT * FROM table_name;`** grabs every row and column:

```sql
SELECT * FROM heroes;
```
lessons.task: Write a query to view all rows and columns from the `heroes` table using `SELECT * FROM heroes;`.

lessons.title: 2. Filtering with WHERE
lessons.concept:
### Searching with WHERE
To find only specific rows, use the **`WHERE`** clause:

```sql
SELECT name, gold FROM heroes WHERE gold > 500;
```
lessons.task: Find all heroes whose level is greater than 10 using `SELECT * FROM heroes WHERE level > 10;`.

lessons.title: 3. The Inventory Table & LIMIT
lessons.concept:
### Limiting Rows with LIMIT
If a table has 1,000,000 items, you only want the top ones! Use **`LIMIT n`**:

```sql
SELECT item_name, cost FROM inventory LIMIT 2;
```
lessons.task: Query the `inventory` table for items where `cost > 50` using `SELECT * FROM inventory WHERE cost > 50;`.
